_source.title: 停止实时 DRC 检查
_source.remarks.text.0: 本接口返回值为结果导向，调用本接口前已停用实时 DRC 检查也将返回 `true`
_source.returns: 是否成功停用实时 DRC 检查

title: Stop real-time DRC check
remarks.text.0: The return value of this API is result-oriented. If real-time DRC check was already disabled before calling this API, `true` will also be returned
returns: Whether real-time DRC check was successfully disabled
